responsibility: This file is a standalone floating-point capability probe program used when porting GCC to a new target or runtime environment. By referencing arithmetic, comparisons, conversions, classification builtins, and common libm entry points across float, double, and long double, it causes the linker to require the corresponding runtime support routines. Its responsibility is therefore build- and porting-time validation of floating-point operation availability, not any compiler pass or runtime library implementation.
